title: Add Slot primitive for asChild prop-merging composition
problem: Components cannot be re-skinned without wrapper nesting; each one re-implements prop forwarding, so agents write boilerplate.
value: asChild lets Touchable, Link, Chip, ListItem render a consumer element while keeping behavior; single merge routine for style/ref/handlers.
scope: Create src/components/Slot/{Slot.tsx,index.ts,Slot.catalog.ts}; one component per directory, no edits to other components or shared barrels (wiring is done by the E4 wiring ticket)

API: <Slot {...props}>{child}</Slot>; export mergeProps(slotProps, childProps) and type SlotProps = ViewProps & {children: ReactElement}. Merge rules: style arrays concatenated (child last wins), handlers chained (child first, then slot), refs merged via useMergedRefs, accessibility* props child wins unless undefined.
States/variants: Throws descriptive __DEV__ error when children is not exactly one valid element; Fragment child rejected.
Accessibility: Never drops accessibilityRole/State from either side; documents that asChild child must be pressable for onPress to work.
Theme tokens used (read-only, no new token keys): none (pure behavioral)
